title: Elastic Constants of Bulk Crystals Using pyiron-workflow and ASE
description: A computational workflow for calculating the elastic constants of bulk crystalline materials using atomistic simulations. The workflow uses pyiron-workflow and the Atomic Simulation Environment (ASE), with the Effective Medium Theory (EMT) interatomic potential. It generates the bulk crystal structure, performs structural relaxation, applies normal and shear strains, evaluates the resulting stresses, and fits the elastic stiffness tensor. It also calculates the Voigt-Reuss-Hill bulk modulus.
